Description: Serves work items from a mailbox: incoming mails become work items over IMAP, and replies go back to the sender over SMTP.

Settings.Label: IMAP host
Settings.HelpText: Hostname of the IMAP server the work-item mailbox is read from.

Settings.Label: Use SSL/TLS
Settings.HelpText: Encrypt the IMAP and SMTP connections.

Settings.Label: Password
Settings.HelpText: Mailbox password; stored encrypted at rest and never displayed back.

Settings.Label: SMTP host
Settings.HelpText: Hostname of the SMTP server replies are sent through.

Settings.Label: Mail folder
Settings.HelpText: IMAP folder that is polled for work-item mails.
